Small faceless chefs with two warm ivory eyes, oversized off-white chef hats, colored sleeves and simple mitten hands. Olive, parchment cream, warm amber firelight against cool deep teal. Stylized readable stone, wood, brass and cooking props. Food-like mess, never realistic gore. NO photorealism, realistic fur, detailed skin, intricate engraved ornament, microtexture, cinematic realism or high-fantasy armor overload. Shape and silhouette carry the design. These are visual proposals, not claims of implemented content.

Create a landscape 3:2 CUTE DUNGEON VERMIN design board. Four clearly separated labelled columns show PANTRY RAT, SOOTLING, FLOUR PUFF and LINT SCUTTLER. Each has a large different low-poly silhouette, a smaller behavior pose and a scale cue. Bottom third is a broad player-eye vignette placing all four tiny creatures in the same dark kitchen/pantry corner with warm lantern or oven light. Rats look like angular rodents, not hooded chefs; sootlings are little black faceted coal puffs, flour puffs are ivory angular dust clouds, lint scuttlers are bundles of scraps with tiny legs. Ivory eye dots where appropriate; expressiveness through body pose and broad shapes, not realistic fur. Approximate sizes10-25cm. Harmless or optional interaction proposals, not mandatory threats or quest-gating. No realistic animal suffering or gore. Short captions only; show the proposed interaction with crumb, hand, jar or props. Do not replace all four species with palette swaps of one body.

SPECIFIC DIRECTION VER-09 - Harmless eyes in the dark: Four very small eye-height pairs under a low shelf reveal the four cute bodies when a lamp reaches them: pointed rat ears, coal spikes, flour cloud and rag fringe. A larger empty doorway remains a separate unknown shape.

Only tiny board identifier VER-09 at the top; prioritize the art itself.
SILHOUETTE VARIATION: Large triangular rat ears; shadow sootling with an eye crack; broad ivory flour halo; umbrella-rag lint scuttler.

jobs.title: The crumb-led scout
jobs.brief: Rat follows a crumb line to an existing hole, sootling points its little body toward warmth, flour puff is tugged by air, lint scuttler catches a loose thread on a hidden shelf edge. A chef mitten offers a tiny crumb.
jobs.notes: Role: optional scouting hint and light interaction. A route stays solvable without understanding the vermin.
